CodraGraph public context for LLMs and AI coding agents

Core reading order:
- README.md - product overview, install commands, package matrix, dashboard usage.
- docs/README.md - public documentation index and architecture reading order.
- docs/INSTALL.md - npm, Bun, local dashboard, hosted dashboard, plugin setup.
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md - runtime topology, ingestion pipeline, graph schema.
- docs/AI_AGENT_CLI_GUIDE.md - supported commands, MCP HTTP behavior, recovery rules.
- docs/STORAGE_AND_RETRIEVAL.md - index size, BM25, embeddings, compression, corruption recovery.
- docs/GUARDRAILS.md - safety boundaries for cleanup, embeddings, MCP routes, and DB files.
- docs/RUNBOOK.md - operational checks and copy-paste recovery commands.

Key runtime packages:
- packages/core - @codragraph/cli: CLI, MCP, HTTP API, indexer, web dashboard bundle.
- apps/web - React/Vite dashboard served by codragraph serve.
- packages/shared - shared graph/API types.
- packages/sdk - programmatic SDK over graph, harness, graphstore, and compression.
- packages/graphstore - content-addressed graph snapshots, diff, branch, merge, blame.
- packages/harness - harness search, swarm, recipe memory.
- packages/compress - context-pack compression utilities.
- packages/org - tenant, RBAC, and audit helpers.

Public repo note:
- The public distribution repo mirrors docs, branding, package README files, and npm tarballs.
- It intentionally excludes private source directories such as packages/, apps/, integrations/, infra/, and marketing/.
- Package README mirrors are under docs/packages/ and docs/integrations/ in the public export.

Agent rules:
- Use GET /api/info for REST health checks.
- Use POST /api/mcp only through an MCP StreamableHTTP client.
- Do not call invented REST routes such as /api/mcp/tools/list.
- Do not delete .codragraph/, edit cgdb/cgdb.wal, or run clean --force without user approval.
- Do not enable --embeddings by default; BM25 and graph search work without vectors.
- Prefer analyze --compress brotli for large repos before adding vectors.
